notes.title: Demo is live!
notes.content: Our demo is out here to try! Try out different shoe combinations, traverse and explore the Footarian Village, build the movesets and get familiar with the controls, movement and much more.

notes.title: Demo Broadcast
notes.content: Our first game, YUBU: THE SHOEVENTURE, we are realising our struggle against resellers on live broadcast. Providing the first theme of the game and giving us various feedbacks will make us very happy during the development phase of our game. You can also access the demo for free.
